title: The Value of Specific Knowledge: Evidence from Disruptions to the Patient-Physician Relationship
eligible_reason: Matched-cohort stacked design, not an unstacked TWFE: control patients are matched to treated patients by calendar quarter and relationship length (07_Sample_Construction.do, match loop over quarters and relationship groups), and every regression absorbs a match-cohort x time fixed effect (annual: fe = group(relationship_group group year); quarterly: group_fe = group(group relationship_group quarter)) plus clinic x time (cy/cq) and provider-specialty FE, and includes the time-varying control military_provider. In addition the analysis data are protected military health records and the package contains only simulated data.
design_notes: Treatment: a patient's primary care physician (PCP) deploys; treatment_quarter = quarter of the PCP's deployment (patient-specific, staggered across 2008-2017). Treated patients are those enrolled with the deploying PCP one year before deployment; controls are patients with the same relationship length in the same calendar quarter whose PCP did not deploy, drawn in a match loop and expanded into a 13-quarter window around the match quarter (stacked by match group). post = 1 for treated patients after the deployment quarter (period 0 dropped), 0 for controls. Main regressions (11_Regressions.do lines 57-65, annual sample): reghdfe y post military_provider, absorb(ID cy specialty fe) cluster(ID clinic), where ID = patient, cy = clinic x year, specialty = provider specialty (time-varying), fe = match-cohort x year. Quarterly versions (lines 116-127) absorb(ID cq specialty group_fe). Event studies (lines 37, 105) use relative-time dummies elapsed* with the same FE and control. Table 5 is a triple difference (treated##post2##info). Robustness: csdid (lines 664-688) with i(ID), t(quarter or year), gvar(group_var) on the matched sample. Outcomes: any_rvu, log_rvu, total_visits, spec, pc, ed, lpm_* and RVU decompositions.

screener_notes: Package directory contained only the two zip archives (regressions list empty); code and README were extracted to the scratchpad for screening. Even setting data access aside, the published specifications are matching-based and stacked with time-varying controls, so no specification meets the protocol. The csdid robustness runs on the matched stacked sample with gvar(group_var) and would not have an eligible TWFE counterpart.
